name: Touto Yachiyo
source:
"Got it, got it. I will slowly, Gently come."

Serves as the homeroom teacher of the main character's class. A math teacher with a cat-like face and personality, also serving as the advisor of the gardening club.
Although lazy and fond of secretly observing, they are a headache-inducing adult.
Always carries a tablet device.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294690/Yomegami_My_Sweet_Goddess/]Steam[/url]]
